name: smwblocks-32x32-blocks-pack
title: 32x32 Blocks pack v2
description:
This package contains:
-A 32x32 brick that can turn into a 32x32 coin when a switch is pressed (default)
-A 32x32 use block (switchable to coin like above)
-A 32x32 question block with customizable items (see definition file).

Unlike previous submissions, ALL 4 blocks of the 32x32 blocks can be triggered by kicked sprites.

See readme for instructions and details. (Fix a block position-related but in vertical levels)

2020/03/07 update: Fixed the splash sprite issue.
